title: Straight stair flight with stringers and a comfort report
purpose: Generate a straight stair flight from rise, going and step count: treads with nosing, optional risers and sloped stringers cut at the floor, plus a report of pitch and the 2R + G step formula. Use it for buildings, decks and level blockouts.

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Number of treads; the flight climbs steps times the rise.

parameters.name: going
parameters.description: Horizontal depth of one step, nosing to nosing.

parameters.name: width
parameters.description: Width of the treads between the stringers.

parameters.name: tread_thickness
parameters.description: Thickness of each tread board; must be less than the rise.

parameters.name: nosing
parameters.description: How far each tread overhangs the step below.

parameters.name: risers
parameters.description: Close each step with a vertical riser board.

parameters.name: stringers
parameters.description: Add a sloped stringer on each side.

parameters.name: stringer_depth
parameters.description: Vertical depth of each stringer below its top edge.

outputs.description: One mesh object named Straight Stairs; its custom property holds 2R + G.

limits: The comfort report applies the common 2R + G rule of thumb (0.60 to 0.65 m) only; it is not a building code check, and codes differ by country and use. No handrail, landing or winder. Parts are separate closed solids in one mesh, touching but not merged. Verified in Blender 5.2.1; written for the 4.2 API.
technique_references: Closed prisms from planar profiles with outward winding
Sutherland-Hodgman clipping of the stringer outline against the floor plane
